verdict.rationale: Workspace message-history export is a fair question for a chat platform, but the evidence pack documents no admin export feature, no machine-readable export formats, and no policy-governed access to private conversations. The REST API, bot tokens and Gateway events are only developer building blocks from which an export tool could be built, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows
